{{Quote|Star Tours introduces the perfect getaway vacation, with exclusive tour packages to Hoth. Now you can ski the most incredible slopes in the galaxy. Or if you prefer, explore beautiful and mysterious ice caverns and the famed Echo Base of the Rebellion forces. And while you're there, be sure to enjoy an exhilarating ride on a Tauntaun. It's all on Hoth, and it all begins soon, only from Star Tours. Watch for details.|Hoth advertisement|<ref name="Star Tours (real-world)">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]], a '''Hoth tour package''' was being planned by the interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]. The destination was to be the ice planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], with planned activities including skiing on Hoth's icy slopes, exploring various ice caverns as well as touring [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], and Tauntaun riding. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], at the time working on preparations for the [[StarSpeeder 3000]] [[Transport 22]] when seeing this message, stated that he did not want to return to the planet while disparagingly referring to it as an "iceberg," with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arguing that it had gotten safer since the last time they've been there.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This tour package was mentioned in a commercial played on the video screen in the queue of the original version of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube Hoth Getaway">{{YouTube|video=t-udMiv1q0U|text=Hoth Getaway - Star Tours|channel=UCVsNHJYZ3Nf4YUnlhiK6NMQ|name=WDWScottsmitty}}</ref>
